# Ondřej Šika

> Ondřej Šika is a DevOps trainer, consultant, and open-source engineer based in the Czech Republic, offering IT training, consulting, and workshops in Europe focused on the DevOps stack (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git, CI/CD, Rancher, Prometheus).

Ondřej Šika (ondrej-sika.cz) is the personal site of Ondřej Šika, founder of [SikaLabs](https://sikalabs.com) and [DevOpsAci.com](https://devopsaci.com). The site is primarily in Czech and covers training courses, public workshops, consulting services, articles, and a devops resource library.

## Training and consulting

- [Školení](https://ondrej-sika.cz/skoleni): Overview of DevOps training courses
- [Veřejné termíny](https://ondrej-sika.cz/verejne-terminy): Public training dates

- [Poptávka školení](https://ondrej-sika.cz/poptavka): Request a training quote
